title: One Home, One Open Policy or Quote: Manufactured Home Insurance Underwriting Rule
content:
**Rule.** Hearthstone Insurance Agency insures under Manufactured Home Insurance the one home a customer lives in on a Hearthstone site, so a customer may hold one open policy or quote at a time — at most 1 per customer. A new quote is issued only when the customer has no other policy in quoted, bound, in force or pending cancellation status.

## How the rule is applied

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Action governed | Issuing a new Manufactured Home Insurance quote |
| Whose holdings are examined | Every Manufactured Home Insurance policy and quote recorded under the same customer |
| Source of the facts | The company's policy records, as they stand before the quote is issued |
| Statuses that count as open | Quoted, bound, in force, pending cancellation |
| Result when an open one exists | No new quote is issued for that customer |

## Status table

| Status of the customer's other policy or quote | Counts as open | A new quote may be issued |
|---|---|---|
| Quoted | Yes | No |
| Bound | Yes | No |
| In force | Yes | No |
| Pending cancellation | Yes | No |
| Cancelled | No | Yes, as far as this rule goes |
| Expired | No | Yes, as far as this rule goes |
| Non-renewed | No | Yes, as far as this rule goes |

## Cases (hypothetical customers)

- A customer whose only earlier policy expired at the end of its term has no open policy; this rule does not stand in the way of a new quote.
- A customer whose policy is pending cancellation for nonpayment still holds an open policy; no new quote is issued while that status stands.
- A customer who already holds an unbound quote holds an open quote; a second quote is not issued alongside it.
